item.title: Rallying Cry – November 17, 2026
item.description: A 73-year-old Mohawk teacher made history with McGill’s first PhD in Indigenous Language Revitalization, China’s cities are getting greener with robots and river breezes, and Hank Green is launching a self-funded educational video platform for kids!
